preconditions.description: The number of clues n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of direct clue links m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The divisor k must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in links)
preconditions.description: Each direct link must connect two distinct clues within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to find exactly T direct links modulo k.
